segments.name: Physician services
segments.description: Provides newborn, maternal-fetal and other pediatric subspecialty physician services, primarily hospital-based, to patients, hospitals and payors nationwide.
segments.evidence: The Company has one reportable segment, which is also its single reporting unit, for purposes of presenting financial information in accordance with the accounting guidance for segment reporting.

revenueModel.text: The company is paid by government healthcare programs and third-party insurance payors for patient services rendered by affiliated physicians, plus hospitals for administrative fees and medical director services.
revenueModel.evidence: Almost all of the Company's patient service revenue is reimbursed by GHC Programs and third-party insurance payors.

changes.text: In 2024 the company exited almost all affiliated office-based practices other than maternal-fetal medicine.
changes.evidence: During 2024, we formalized our practice portfolio management plans, resulting in a decision to exit almost all of our affiliated office-based practices, other than maternal-fetal medicine.

changes.text: In 2024 the company exited its primary and urgent care service line.
changes.evidence: Additionally, we exited our primary and urgent care service line during 2024 based on a review of the cost and time that would be required to build the platform to scale.
